title: Spacetime Mini Tensor kernel
purpose: A sparse, labelled data foundation for reproducible comparisons of temporal structure, self-similarity and coherence against chance. Kernel is a data contract, not a fitted model or an executing tensor engine.

access.discovery: Unlisted, noindex; accessible to anyone with the URL.
access.ai: Read directly over HTTPS. A future MCP adapter can expose this immutable snapshot as a resource.

dimensions.representation: Ragged series of native observations; no fabricated dense time grid.
dimensions.missing: null and valid=false; an absent period is missing, never zero.
dimensions.release_time: available_at=null means release time is unknown. This snapshot is unsuitable for claims of real-time predictive performance without point-in-time data.

provenance.source_license_policy: Each series retains its own terms. Inclusion grants no additional redistribution rights.
provenance.revision_policy: Regenerate from source modules; increment snapshot/version when values or semantics change. Hash the downloaded kernel bytes when recording an analysis.

models.label: Fibonacci sequence
models.definition: F0=0; F1=1; Fn+2=(Fn+1+Fn) mod 9. The 24-step state cycle repeats.
models.technical_note: M9 / P24 alpha; Atlas display 9 represents native residue 0.

models.label: King Wen sequence
models.definition: Traditional order; yang=1, yin=0; bottom line is least significant bit; integer mod 9.
models.technical_note: The modulo transform is experimental; it is separate from the historical Timewave algorithm.

models.label: Timewave Zero
models.valid_domain: Times at or before the declared zero; undefined afterwards.
models.interpretation: Lower curve values represent greater novelty in this historical model; no empirical measure of human evolution is implied.

shared_clock.zen_rendering: Native sequence values held for one step; changing viewport never changes the clock or origin
shared_clock.research_rendering: Selected transform; values mode retains linear interpolation
shared_clock.phase_convention: One sequence value per step; calendar month/year boundaries; days are elapsed 24-hour intervals.
shared_clock.limits: This clock evaluates mathematical models. It does not increase the temporal resolution of observations.

concepts.coherence: A specified statistical dependence or shared temporal structure at declared scales, assessed against a suitable null model.
concepts.self_similarity: Similarity across scales within a series or between series; choose a metric and scale range before testing.
concepts.chance: Compatibility with a declared stochastic null model; weak evidence is not proof of randomness.
concepts.chaos: Deterministic chaos requires a separately specified nonlinear dynamical analysis. Low coherence or high entropy alone is insufficient.
concepts.meaning: Interpretation needs domain evidence and plausible mechanisms; resemblance alone establishes neither causality nor human benefit.

preparation.alignment: Select actual overlapping periods and declare any scientifically justified aggregation; never upsample annual wellbeing into three-hour observations.
preparation.solar_resolution: Choose annual or monthly SILSO per comparison; the two versions are dependent representations.
preparation.geography: Declare scope mismatches explicitly, including global survey aggregates versus US markets.
preparation.stationarity: Assess trends, seasonality and serial dependence. Fit preprocessing on training data only.
preparation.uncertainty: Retain source bounds and null masks; do not invent confidence intervals.
preparation.source_dependence: Indicators in the same dependence group are not independent replications.

candidate_methods.purpose: Correlation or regression at predefined lags
Local dependence across time and scale
requirements: Correct across scales, lags and indicator searches
Adequate sample size and stationary segments

validation.null_model: Select and justify surrogates or block resampling preserving relevant autocorrelation, distributions and seasonality. IID shuffling is unsuitable when dependence is present.
validation.search_accounting: Register every tested indicator, scale, lag, phase and transform in one comparison family, including unsuccessful runs.
validation.multiple_testing: Declare a family-wide correction and report raw and adjusted evidence; independent agents share the same search ledger.
validation.holdout: Reserve chronological data before fitting or selecting patterns; new data or independent populations provide stronger replication.
validation.prediction: Unknown publication times prevent an as-of forecasting claim from this snapshot.
validation.report: Report effect sizes, uncertainty, actual observation counts, effective sample size estimates, missingness, sensitivity and negative findings.

agent_protocol.execution: Future integration; no agents launched by this JSON.
agent_protocol.immutable_inputs: Pin the kernel SHA-256 and source snapshot in every task.
agent_protocol.registration: Assign one hypothesis ID and comparison-family ID before analysis; record all agents and runs.
agent_protocol.reproducibility: Record code revision, software versions, parameters and random seeds.
agent_protocol.shared_budget: Coordinator declares total runs and resource limits before dispatch.
agent_protocol.interpretation: Agent agreement alone is not independent scientific evidence.

analysis_contract.outcome_limit: Supported association is conditional on the declared test and validation. It is not a causal finding, a trading signal or a proof of universal coherence.
